'''Cloud Connector Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://goarbo.com/blog/new-plaquemines-expansion/|title=goarbo.com|website=goarbo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2026/september/baker-hughes-and-venture-global-advance-next-phase-of-us-gas-infrastructure-growth|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Haynesville area, Louisiana to Plaquemines LNG, Louisiana.
